hero_kpi_rationale: The top drug revenue is the primary growth driver in JNJ's pharma segment, which represents a major portion of its total revenue. Although the blockbuster name is not disclosed here, this KPI reflects strategic dependence on its key pharma franchises.

kpis.name: Top Drug Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the company's best-selling drug.
kpis.description: JNJ's top drug continues to grow slightly, supported by strong global penetration and resilient demand.

kpis.name: Advanced R&D Pipeline
kpis.explanation: Number of drugs in phase 3 clinical trials, the final stage before approval.
kpis.description: JNJ has a solid portfolio of molecules in advanced stages, particularly in oncology and immunology, ensuring medium-term visibility.
kpis.signal: Robust pipeline in oncology and immunology

kpis.name: Operating Margin (Core)
kpis.explanation: Profit margin after operating costs, excluding non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Operating margin is improving due to better cost management and the spin-off of Kenvue, which has refocused the business.

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Proportion of research and development expenses in revenue.
kpis.description: The R&D-to-revenue ratio has declined following the Kenvue spin-off, but investments remain high in strategic therapeutic areas.

kpis.name: Niche Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from vaccines and specialty care such as oncology.
kpis.description: The specialty care segment shows solid growth, driven by new product launches in oncology and immunology.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated after investments and operating expenses.
kpis.description: JNJ generates high and consistent FCF, supporting dividends and share buybacks despite legal challenges.

kpis.name: Recent FDA Approval
kpis.explanation: Drug recently approved by the FDA, launched less than two years ago.
kpis.description: A new oncology treatment was approved by the FDA in 2025, marking a strategic milestone for the pipeline.

kpis.name: Multi-site Production Capex
kpis.description: JNJ has increased its production capex to support new product launches and secure the supply chain.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 94.193 Bn USD in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of 26.804 Bn USD in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions cybersecurity risks and has implemented measures to mitigate them, but it remains a major challenge.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The healthcare sector is highly competitive, and JNJ faces increasing competition to maintain its market share.

risks.title: Regulatory
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes and compliance requirements can have a significant impact on JNJ's operations and financial results.

risks.title: Major Legal Risks (talc, etc.)
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions major litigation involving thousands of plaintiffs related to talc-based products (JOHNSON'S Baby Powder), with potentially significant financial exposure.

risks.title: Dependence on Key Products
risks.score_rationale: JNJ is highly dependent on a few key products, making it vulnerable to any decline or patent loss in these products.

risks.title: Clinical Trial Risks
risks.score_rationale: Clinical trials are essential for new product development, but they carry risks, particularly regarding safety and efficacy.

risks.title: Supply Chain Management
risks.score_rationale: Supply chain management is complex and can be affected by various factors, such as component shortages or delivery delays.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: JNJ's operations are global, exposing the company to geopolitical risks, including changes in trade policy or conflicts.
